notes: Near-black (#0a0a0c) page with white text; nav is a centered floating pill (fully rounded links, white GitHub button) that stays fixed on scroll. Mono uppercase tracked eyebrows in a faint cyan/grey give a terminal feel. The product demo sits in a 14px-radius window frame with a mono title bar 'FLOE DESKTOP · 1.1.1' and a status bar with cyan code text, plus a faint glow. Alternative downloads are a hairline-divided three-column list (title / description / right-aligned bold text links) instead of buttons. The only real button-like CTA is the official Microsoft Store badge image. The style summary's #ffffff background is a capture artifact; visually the page is dark.
